S_branch.note: Keras 3 cannot apply the legacy S-branch multi-head-attention checkpoint by name. After the name-based attempt fails, load_weights is positional. skip_mismatch=True is forbidden for paper runs. picker_S (and picker_P / first P conv) kernels are then compared to the HDF5 arrays.

n_errors_policy: A skipped variable or HDF5 kernel mismatch raises and is counted in n_errors, never as a successful window.
